title: Families selected for the program by demographics
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Families selected for the program by demographics, about 1960s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And they also chose it by demographics too because they um they knew that a certain percentage of offspring would want to go into the military

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA, the US government's code and signals spy agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells this on Jesse Michels's podcast. He says a superior he calls Captain White told him that families were picked for the secret program in the 1960s partly by their background, because the planners knew a certain share of the children would want to join the military. If true, it would mean the program was planned across generations.
